input.quote: 10. NONASSIGNABILITY. Neither party shall assign, transfer, or subcontract this Agreement or any of its obligations hereunder without the other party's express, prior written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld.
input.rationale: Section 10 imposes a symmetric consent requirement (not unreasonably withheld) on all assignments, so it meets the fallback but not the preferred position: it gives us no carve-out to assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, and it does not prevent Contractor from assigning to one of our competitors. Section 6 contains no change-of-control termination or re-pricing trigger (searches for "change of control" return nothing), so no deletion is needed; we add a confirming sentence to foreclose that argument. Minimal edit appends the carve-out to the existing sentence and preserves the mutual consent standard for other assignments.

ops.oldText: which will not be unreasonably withheld.
ops.newText: which will not be unreasonably withheld; provided that Company may assign this Agreement, without Contractor's consent, to an affiliate or to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, and Contractor shall not assign this Agreement to a competitor of Company. No change of control of Company shall give Contractor any right to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement or any Statement of Work.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added our customary carve-out allowing us to assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger or sale of substantially all assets, barred assignment by Contractor to our competitors, and confirmed that a change of control of Company gives Contractor no termination or re-pricing right. Mutual consent (not unreasonably withheld) is preserved for all other assignments.
proposal.summary: Add Customer affiliate/successor assignment carve-out, no assignment to Customer competitors, and no Vendor rights on Customer change of control.
